bible.title: The Cinnamon Horn
bible.kernel: A dead man's horse purchases point to an elf who now guards a carved horn that opens a hoard.

cast.name: Menelaos of Millbrook
cast.who: Miller of Millbrook who keeps the town's wheel and fears losing the grazing deed.
cast.want: to recover the carved horn Elonde Brightwater holds

cast.name: Elonde Brightwater
cast.who: An elf hunter from the Western Forests, sickly and serious, prone to omission.
cast.want: to keep the carved horn that opens the Thornvault

cast.name: Alfe Greenmantle
cast.who: A woman of the woods who sheltered Elonde and answers softly, leaving things out.
cast.want: to protect the hollow root where the horn now rests

bible.situation: Menelaos hired the company to take from Elonde Brightwater a carved horn he took after a dead man was seen buying horses at three fairs. The true state: Elonde fell ill and sheltered with Alfe Greenmantle in the Western Forests. He used coins from a small hidden hoard to buy horses. The horn is the tool that opens the hoard beneath Millbrook's old sluice. The hunter smells faintly of cinnamon. Alfe speaks gently and omits the horn's exact place until pressed. The company must find the horn and return it to Menelaos.
bible.goal: Recover the carved horn Elonde Brightwater holds.
arc: Go to Hillsreach Fair, the first ground the client named, and question stablehands about the dead man seen buying horses → yields: a cinnamon-stained saddle plaque stamped with Elonde Brightwater's crest.

Use the crest to travel to Greenmantle Hollow and press the woodswoman who sheltered the hunter about his purchases → yields: a half-burned note in Elonde Brightwater's hand pointing to the old sluice beneath Millbrook Market.
Go to Millbrook Market, force the sluice hatch the note points to, recover the carved horn and settle the claim in front of Menelaos while Elonde resists and is subdued there
tensions: Elonde refuses to yield the horn and will fight to keep it
Alfe's gentleness hides omissions that slow the search
Rumors from the fairs draw curious claimants toward the hoard
openDirections: News of the horn leaks through fairs and lanes, inviting rival bands to the Western Forests.
bible.stakeIfLost: Menelaos says the family grazing deed kept in the hoard will be seized and his mill sold if the horn is not returned.
bible.arrival: came behind a letter that said less · was in a hurry and did not hide it

shipped.title: Ask stablehands at Hillsreach Fair
shipped.situation: A miller, Menelaos of Millbrook, came behind a sparse letter and wants the carved horn Elonde Brightwater holds, the coin comes when it is done, and anything carried home is the company's. He says the family grazing deed in the hoard will be seized and his mill sold if the horn is not returned. He asks you to go to Hillsreach Fair and question stablehands about the dead man who bought horses. An elf hunter, Elonde Brightwater, keeps the carved horn that opens the Thornvault. He watches your hands, not your face.
shipped.job: Identify which stablehands at Hillsreach Fair saw the dead man who bought horses.
